_comment: Dynamic-region masking + per-page visual thresholds for the pixelmatch runner. A 'mask' is a list of CSS selectors painted over (filled flat) on BOTH sites before diffing, so legitimately non-deterministic content (which graduate photos exist, which testimonials/recent-blog posts surface, rendered relative dates) does not register as a parity failure. We match a stable data-* hook FIRST (the WP theme SHOULD emit [data-graduates]/[data-testimonials]/[data-recent-blogs]/[data-mask='date'] on these sections — reported to the team lead, not yet in the theme data-contract), falling back to id/class/href + <time> selectors that also work on the live Next site so the baseline can be captured today.
_thresholdNote: maxDiffPixelRatio is the share of total pixels allowed to differ (0.0-1.0) after anti-alias-tolerant comparison. Tighter on text-heavy static pages, looser where masking is imperfect or large media dominates. `pixelmatchThreshold` (0-1) is pixelmatch's per-pixel color-distance tolerance; 0.1 ignores sub-perceptual AA noise. These are STARTING values — Task #9 will tune them against the real WP build and record any change here with a one-line reason.

home.reason: hero gradient/glow + masked graduates+testimonials+recent-blogs; most dynamic page
